Launched by chain-after.sh when oretunnel-03 ends, choosing the variant by fleet sha.] LOST TABLE CRAFTS (10-03, sandbox, Paper 1.21.8, real craft skill, RCON oracle): mineflayer 4.37.1 fires window clicks without waiting and keeps ONE global stateId, so the server rejects and resyncs mid-craft; control lost 13 of 29 table crafts while reporting success, over-crafted 7 times ('4 sticks' -> 16) and 4 false failures. Fleet, 3 h 10-03: 118 of 994 craft rows ended 'nothing changed' -- every one a 'crafted Nx <item>' claim (38 stone_pickaxe, 33 wooden_pickaxe, 22 crafting_table). THE FIX (both engines reviewed; Claude AGREE, Codex's rare mixed-plank planning gap accepted as documented and fail-safe): clicks in lockstep with the server (quiet wait per click, one forced resync on opening a container), each craft verified by window-0 resyncs before/after (craft_unconfirmed otherwise), count = ITEMS, whole-tree planner crafts each intermediate once. Sandbox 38/38 + 27/27, 0 lost, exact counts; ~1-2 s slower per craft. Row `_craft_sync` per bot.craft. KNOWN TRADE-OFF (Claude review): bots ask to craft tools they already hold; now those succeed and spend materials -- reported as duplicate_tool_crafts, not gated.
